info.name: Viora API Collection
info.description: Full REST API collection for Viora multiplayer social game backend (NestJS + Fastify + Supabase Auth). Run Auth endpoints first to get a Bearer token, then use it in all protected endpoints.

request.description: Register a new user with email and password. Returns access and refresh tokens.
Login with email and password. Returns access and refresh tokens.
Request OTP for email verification (passwordless registration).
Verify email OTP and complete registration.
Refresh access token using a valid refresh token.
Logout the current user. Invalidates the session. Requires Bearer token.
Request a one-time password (OTP) to be sent to a phone number. Rate limited.
Verify the OTP sent to the phone number and get auth tokens.
Begin MFA enrollment. Returns MFA secret and QR code URI. Requires Bearer token.
Verify and enable MFA with a TOTP code. Requires Bearer token.
Get Google OAuth URL for SSO login.
Google OAuth callback. Exchange auth code for tokens.
Get Facebook OAuth URL for SSO login.
Facebook OAuth callback. Exchange auth code for tokens.
Link a social provider (Facebook, phone, or email) to the current account. Requires Bearer token.
Register an FCM token for push notifications. Requires Bearer token.
Get current user's profile, basic info, and equipped loadout. Requires Bearer token.
Bootstrap user data on app load — profile, settings, and initial data. Requires Bearer token.
Update current user's profile. All fields are optional. Requires Bearer token.
Update the current user's avatar URL. Requires Bearer token.
Update the current user's equipped profile cosmetics. Requires Bearer token.
Update the current user's online presence status. Requires Bearer token.
Enable or disable email OTP verification for the account.

variable.description: The immutable user ID from Supabase

request.description: Get another user's public profile by their immutable user ID. Requires Bearer token.
List all active public voice rooms. This is a PUBLIC route — no auth required.
Create a new voice room. You can only own one active room at a time.
Get room details by ID. This is a PUBLIC route — no auth required.
Get all members of a room. PUBLIC route — no auth required.
Join a voice room. Requires Bearer token.
Leave a voice room. Requires Bearer token.
Get chat history for a room. Requires Bearer token.
Kick a user from the room. Only owners/moderators can kick. Requires Bearer token.
Ban a user from the room. Only owners/moderators can ban. Requires Bearer token.
Unban a user from the room. Only owners/moderators can unban. Requires Bearer token.
Mute a user in the room. Only owners/moderators can mute. Requires Bearer token.
Unmute a user in the room. Requires Bearer token.
Assign a rank/role to a user in the room. Only owners can assign roles. Requires Bearer token.
Remove a role from a user in the room. Only owners can remove roles. Requires Bearer token.
Transfer room ownership to another member. Only current owner can transfer. Requires Bearer token.
Close a voice room. Only the owner can close. Requires Bearer token.
Reopen a closed voice room. Only the owner can reopen. Requires Bearer token.
Update the state of a mic slot (open/taken/locked). Requires Bearer token.
Update room theme (background). Only owners can update theme. Requires Bearer token.
Update room wallpaper/background. Only owners can update. Requires Bearer token.
Update room slogan/description. Only owners can update. Requires Bearer token.
Pin a chat message in the room. Only owners/moderators can pin. Requires Bearer token.
Get all pinned messages in a room. Requires Bearer token.
Unpin a message from the room. Only owners/moderators can unpin. Requires Bearer token.
Delete a chat message from the room. Only owners/moderators can delete. Requires Bearer token.
Get all banned users in a room. Only owners/moderators can view bans. Requires Bearer token.
Get all kicked users in a room. Only owners/moderators can view. Requires Bearer token.
Get all muted users in a room. Only owners/moderators can view. Requires Bearer token.
Get all moderators in a room. Only owners can view. Requires Bearer token.

query.description: Filter by scope: profile, room, game
Filter by game type (e.g., ludo, domino)

request.description: List all available store items. Requires Bearer token.
Create a new store item. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
List all available store bundles. Requires Bearer token.
Purchase a bundle. Deducts currency and creates inventory items. Requires Bearer token.

query.description: Filter: active (default, excludes expired), all, expired

request.description: Get current user's inventory. By default excludes expired items. Requires Bearer token.
Purchase a single item. Requires Bearer token.
Gift a purchase to another user. Deducts gems from sender immediately. Requires Bearer token.
Equip an item from inventory to a slot. Requires Bearer token.
Unequip an item from a slot (revert to default). Requires Bearer token.
Get current user's equipped loadout (equipped items per slot). Requires Bearer token.
Get user's loadout merged with default items for slots without equipped items. Requires Bearer token.
Validate that user's equipped cosmetics are valid for a specific game type. Requires Bearer token.
Get gifts received by the current user (pending/accepted/declined). Requires Bearer token.
Accept a received gift. Adds item to inventory. Requires Bearer token.
Decline a received gift. Refunds gems to the sender. Requires Bearer token.
Get gifts sent by the current user. Requires Bearer token.
Use a consumable item from inventory. Requires Bearer token.
Create a new private match. The creator is automatically added as a player. Requires Bearer token.
Join a private match using a room code. Only works for games with isPrivate=true and joinMethod in ['code', 'both']. Requires Bearer token.
Invite a player to a private match. Only the match creator can invite. Requires Bearer token.
Accept a match invite. Adds sender as player in the match. Requires Bearer token.
Decline a match invite. Requires Bearer token.
Get all pending match invites for the current user. Requires Bearer token.
Get match history for the current user. Requires Bearer token.
Get detailed information about a specific match. Requires Bearer token.
Get chat messages from a match. Requires Bearer token.
Join the matchmaking queue for a game type. Rate limited by ThrottlerGuard. Requires Bearer token.
Leave the matchmaking queue. Rate limited. Requires Bearer token.
Get the current daily login streak status and available rewards. Requires Bearer token.
Claim today's daily login reward. Increments streak. Requires Bearer token.
Get all available tasks (daily/weekly) with progress for the current user. Requires Bearer token.
Claim reward for a completed task. Requires Bearer token.
Get the current user's ranking for a specific game type. Requires Bearer token.
Get the global leaderboard for a specific game type. Requires Bearer token.
Get another user's ranking for a specific game type. Requires Bearer token.
Get the friends leaderboard for a specific game type. Requires Bearer token.
Send a friend request to another user. Requires Bearer token.
Accept a pending friend request. Creates a friendship. Requires Bearer token.
Get the current user's friend list. Requires Bearer token.
Block another user. Also removes them from friends. Requires Bearer token.
Mute a user (hide their messages/notifications). Requires Bearer token.
Get direct message history with a friend. Requires Bearer token.
Reject a pending friend request. Requires Bearer token.
Cancel a sent friend request. Requires Bearer token.
Unblock a previously blocked user. Requires Bearer token.
Unmute a previously muted user. Requires Bearer token.
Get current user's wallet balance (gold and gems). Requires Bearer token.
Get transaction history for the current user. Requires Bearer token.
Get all notifications for the current user. Requires Bearer token.
Mark a specific notification as read. Requires Bearer token.
Mark all notifications as read. Requires Bearer token.
Create a new report against a user. Requires Bearer token.

query.description: Filter by status: open, investigating, resolved, dismissed

request.description: List all reports (admin/mod/support only). Requires Bearer token + MODERATOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN, or SUPPORT role.
Get reports filed by the current user. Requires Bearer token.
Get details of a specific report. Requires Bearer token + MODERATOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN, or SUPPORT role.
Add evidence to a report. Requires Bearer token + MODERATOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN, or SUPPORT role.
Take action on a report (warn, mute, ban, etc.). Requires Bearer token + MODERATOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN, or SUPPORT role.
Update the status of a report. Requires Bearer token + MODERATOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN, or SUPPORT role.
Assign a report to a moderator/support agent. Requires Bearer token + MODERATOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN, or SUPPORT role.

query.description: Filter by status: open, in_progress, resolved, closed

request.description: List all support tickets (admin/support only). Requires Bearer token + SUPPORT or ADMIN role.
Get the current user's own support tickets. Requires Bearer token.
Get details of a specific support ticket. Requires Bearer token.
Create a new support ticket. Requires Bearer token.
Reply to a support ticket. Requires Bearer token.
Update ticket status (admin/support only). Requires Bearer token + SUPPORT or ADMIN role.
Assign ticket to a support agent. Requires Bearer token + SUPPORT or ADMIN role.
Add an internal note to a ticket. Requires Bearer token + SUPPORT or ADMIN role.
Issue a sanction (ban/mute/warning) to a user. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role + GLOBAL_BAN permission.
Add a strike (penalty point) to a user. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role + GLOBAL_BAN permission.
Get all active sanctions for a user. Requires Bearer token.
Get all available system roles. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Get all roles assigned to a specific user. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Assign a role to a user. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Revoke a role from a user. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Adjust a user's wallet balance (add or deduct). Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Get all available permissions. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Get all permissions assigned to a specific role. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Assign a permission to a role. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Revoke a permission from a role. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Create a new system role. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN role.
Update an existing role. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN role.
Create a new permission. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
List all users with pagination. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Get detailed information about a specific user. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Process a refund for a store purchase. Restores currency and removes purchased items. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Get all system ranks. Requires Bearer token.
Create a new system rank. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Assign a system rank to a user. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Revoke a system rank from a user. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Get all system ranks assigned to a specific user. Requires Bearer token.
Get the current user's system ranks. Requires Bearer token.
Get all room-specific ranks for a voice room. Requires Bearer token.
Create a new room-specific rank. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Assign a room rank to a user. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Revoke a room rank from a user. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Get all room ranks assigned to a user in a specific room. Requires Bearer token.
Get the current user's ranks in a specific room. Requires Bearer token.
Get the current user's accessible system configuration. Requires Bearer token.
Get all system configuration values. Requires Bearer token.
Get all feature flags. Requires Bearer token.
Check if a specific feature flag is enabled. Requires Bearer token.
Set a system configuration value. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Create or update a feature flag. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Refresh the in-memory config cache from the database. Requires Bearer token + SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN role.
Get a voice token for joining a voice room. Requires Bearer token.
Get a voice token for in-game voice chat. Requires Bearer token.
Mute or unmute own microphone in a match. Requires Bearer token.
Get own microphone state in a match. Requires Bearer token.
Admin/moderator control - disable/enable user mic in a match. Requires Bearer token + MODERATOR, ADMIN, or SUPER_ADMIN role.
List all media files. Requires Bearer token.
Get details of a specific media file. Requires Bearer token.
Basic health check. PUBLIC route — no auth required.
Readiness check (includes DB and Redis connectivity). PUBLIC route — no auth required.
Application metrics (request counts, latencies, errors). PUBLIC route — no auth required.
